news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹13.18 (vs ₹6.62 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹13.18 (up from ₹6.62 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.80b (up 25% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹131.5m (up 99% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.7% (up from 2.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 2% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.3% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (9.3% average weekly change). Market cap is less than US$100m (₹1.78b market cap, or US$18.6m).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.24 (vs ₹2.55 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.24 (down from ₹2.55 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹657.9m (up 22% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹22.4m (down 12% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.4% (down from 4.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 33% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 3% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
